items.title: Royal Thai Embassy (Singapore) Spun Pile Export
items.scope: In 2005, Pathumthani Concrete exported prestressed concrete spun piles to Singapore for several projects, including the Royal Thai Embassy.
items.deliverables: Prestressed concrete spun pile manufacturing and export delivery per official site records.

items.scope: Foundation piling utilizing C60A prestressed concrete spun piles driven by PD (Pure Drive) system per official project records.

items.title: Precast Box Girders Fabricated per BMA Public Works Design (1985 Onwards)
items.scope: Starting in 1985, Pathumthani Concrete commenced fabrication of precast prestressed concrete box girders in accordance with the standard designs of the Department of Public Works, Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA).
items.deliverables: Precast prestressed concrete box girder manufacturing per BMA standard designs.

items.title: Roge & Associates Corporate Engineering Consulting Profile
items.scope: Founded in 1983 by a group of Thai engineers; registered as a Grade A consulting firm with the Fiscal Policy Office, Ministry of Finance; team of more than 105 permanent professional staff.
items.deliverables: Multi-disciplined engineering consultancy, planning, feasibility studies, design, and construction supervision.
